events.title: DEMO PATCH: Improved Stealth, Streamlined Controls & AI Adjustments
events.summary: WHAT’S NEW IN THIS PATCHMore Realistic Audio DetectionMaking noise by stepping on debris previously gave the stalker your exact coordinates. The AI logic has been updated so noise now alerts him to your general area, giving you a fair chance to reposition or hide before he arrives.Streamlined Leaning ControlsPeeking around corners is now smoother. You no longer need to hold Q first—simply press LMB or RMB when near a wall edge or cover object to lean in that direction.Improved Cover & Visibility

events.title: Demo Update: The Flashlight Patch & Visual Adjustments
events.summary: Full Patch NotesNew Feature: Flashlight & Battery MechanicsFlashlight Pickup: Added a collectible retro metal flashlight near the beginning of the demo.Control Toggle: Press \ to equip/unequip and toggle the light on or off.Limited Resource: Power is finite—use the light sparingly to avoid running dry in pitch-black areas.Beam-Angle Detection: You must keep the light angled toward the floor. events.title: AI & Stealth Rework
events.summary: AI & Stealth ReworkIncreased AI Aggression: The stalker is now significantly more hostile and responsive to player presence.High-Stakes Hiding: Stepping into illuminated areas or making noise now triggers an immediate pursuit. Players must stick to the shadows and remain in a hiding spot during a cooldown period to reset the killer's alert state.Unpredictable Scares: Ambient jump scares now trigger while the killer is in an unalerted patrolling state.Gameplay & EscalationEndgame Pressure: Acquir
